name: unconditional-reset
declaration: class Child : IDevice { public Child() { GyroMatrix = new() { Axis = new Vector3(-1,1,1) }; } }

name: conditional-assignment
declaration: class Child : IDevice { public Child() { if (DateTime.Now.Ticks > 0) GyroMatrix = new(); } }

name: method-assignment
declaration: class Child : IDevice { void Change() { GyroMatrix = new(); } }

name: member-mutation
declaration: class Child : IDevice { public Child() { GyroMatrix.Axis = new Vector3(1,1,-1); } }

name: dictionary-mutation
declaration: class Child : IDevice { public Child() { GyroMatrix.AxisSwap.Clear(); } }

name: callback-assignment
declaration: class Child : IDevice { public Child() { Action change = () => GyroMatrix = new(); } }

name: constructor-overloads
declaration: class Child : IDevice { public Child() : this(1) {} public Child(int x) { GyroMatrix = new(); } }

name: early-return
declaration: class Child : IDevice { public Child() { if(DateTime.Now.Ticks > 0) return; GyroMatrix = new(); } }
